newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's bank liquidity dips 1.1 percent in August.
newsitem.headline: Peru's bank liquidity dips 1.1 percent in August.

text.p: Peru's total banking system liquidity fell 1.1 percent, or 298 million soles, to 27.795 billion soles during August, the Central Reserve Bank said Monday.

Liquidity in the local sol currency fell 1.7 percent to 9.321 billion soles in August, according to the bank's weekly report. Foreign currency liquidity dipped 0.7 percent to $7.510 billion in the same period.
Total liquidity stood at 22.483 billion soles at the end of 1995.
